answer: Sponsor slots in dawn are one-shot: a nebula needs three backers with disjoint ancestry, each locking sable equal to its depth in dawn. Shallow slots go first, so the kth nebula must recruit at depth at least k, and every fresh sponsor must itself be sponsored, adding a hop and a lock. The bill is k sable per sponsor entry, rising with each head and taken atomically at commit. It breaks if ancestry is self-declared, sable refundable, or slots transfer.
